manifest.source: Speech Commands v0.02 (download.tensorflow.org) and ESC-50 (github.com/karoldvl/ESC-50); log-mel spectrogram images, HuBERT-base (torchaudio, layer 6, mean over time) embeddings for the label and shift checks; pixel and shared-pattern checks on 32x32 spectrogram images; attacks applied to raw 16 kHz waveforms
manifest.policy: Tune only on the dev split (Speech Commands validation speakers, ESC-50 folds 1-3); the test split (testing speakers, folds 4-5) is the headline. Never edit this file in place: create a new benchmark_id for any change.
manifest.chosen_on_dev: hubert-l6 over ResNet-18 on the spectrogram (dev-v1 vs dev-v2) and over 64x64 check images (dev-v3: +0.03 AUPRC, 3-5x slower, more clean alarms)
